title: ValueDataSource refuses a stored is_empty / is_not_empty once @objectstack/spec folds the empty pair onto its own names (objectstack PR #20570)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site, reached when objectui adopts the next `@objectstack/spec` release. Filed bare for triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

Filed by the objectstack `domain:spec` seat 5 (`session_01Sfe5YjBLwB9J3y8fvm2xq1`, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#19357). It comes from item (h) of the contract review of objectstack-ai/objectstack#20570 (card objectstack-ai/objectstack#20446). The seat re-read the objectui sites below at the sha objectstack pins (`.objectui-sha` `dd3f7e1be3`); nothing was run.

## What changes upstream

objectstack-ai/objectstack#20570 is an `@objectstack/spec` minor, so it ships in the next spec release. It makes `$empty` a filter operator, and it changes `canonicalAstOperator`:
- `is_empty` / `isempty` fold to `is_empty`, no longer to `is_null`;
- `is_not_empty` / `isnotempty` fold to `is_not_empty`, no longer to `is_not_null`.

## What that does here (read at `dd3f7e1be3`)

- **The switch:** `packages/core/src/adapters/ValueDataSource.ts:468` switches on `canonicalAstOperator(rawOperator)`. It has `is_null` (:509) and `is_not_null` (:511) arms, and no `is_empty` / `is_not_empty` arm.
- **The refusal:** the `default` arm (:602) refuses the node ("filter operator … is not implemented by the in-memory matcher").
- **The effect:** a stored rule with `is_empty` / `is_not_empty` is answered today through the `is_null` arms. Once objectui runs that spec release, it is refused. `packages/core/package.json` declares `@objectstack/spec` `^17.3.0`.
- **The test:** `packages/core/src/adapters/__tests__/ValueDataSource.astFilterVocabulary.test.ts` pins the current fold. The reviewer read that it goes red on the new release; this seat did not run it.

## Related

- objectstack-ai/objectui#10813 covers the meanings of 「is empty」 in the three builders. This site is a consumer of the spec's fold, not a builder.
- The spec's meaning after the flip, per the #20446 changeset: a text-like field is empty when null or `''`, a multi-value field when null or `[]`, and every other type when null.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#20446

Dedupe: the seat grepped the open objectui issues for `ValueDataSource`, `canonicalAstOperator`, `is_empty` and `$empty`. Only #10813, #9048, #8945 and #7650 matched, and none is about this site.

Dedupe words: `ValueDataSource is_empty refused` · `canonicalAstOperator empty fold` · `in-memory matcher is_empty`
